notes: Answers: the name and EIN are repeated at the top of page 2. tax_year 'Fiscal year ending: month and day' or '52-53-week year ending with reference to: month' ticks the box and writes the month. Up to three shareholders: name and address in column J, 'number of shares or percentage, date acquired' in column L, and the tax year end in column N. Column K (each shareholder's consent signature and date) and column M (each shareholder's SSN or EIN) are left for the shareholders: Placetta never writes an SSN. 'None' leaves an optional line blank; 'No' leaves G's box blank. Parts II to IV (fiscal year and QSub elections), the officer's signature and its date are left for the signer. The XFA layer is dropped by the filler so the filled boxes show. A corporation with a nonresident alien shareholder can't be an S corporation.
